verdict.rationale: Navan documents a single API with retrieve and update endpoints across expense transactions (card, manual, Connect), plus custom-field management and batch option values. An agent can therefore pull transactions and write coding back. The official MCP server adds natural-language access to flagged expenses, policy violations and flag/decline reasons, which supports proposing categorizations and policy flags. missing for 10: an explicit filter for uncoded transactions, a documented review or approval staging step for agent-pushed coding, MCP write/update capability (the MCP appears query-oriented), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
